standard-dialogue-with-ghostspeak-amulet.npc: Oh how splendid! Every time I come back here I try to talk to people, but no one seems to understand.
I was telling my friend Bob this the other day in the afterlife. At least he can relate to the struggle of people not understanding.

standard-dialogue-with-ghostspeak-amulet.text: If the player has not completed Dragon Slayer II:
If the player has completed Dragon Slayer II:

steps.player: Wait a second. Your friend Bob... does he happen to be a cat?

steps.npc: Why, yes, he is! Do you know Bob?

steps.player: I do! How is he doing?

steps.npc: He's alright, all things considered. He did speak of a human friend he misses though. I suspect that's you.

steps.player: I miss him too. Could you tell him I said hi? And tell him I'm sorry he got killed. I wish I could have saved him.

steps.npc: I will tell him that you miss him. Regarding his death, he said it was necessary, so please don't feel bad about it.
He never explained why, only said that it had to be that way.

options.text: What can you tell me about Eve?

steps.player: What can you tell me about Eve?

steps.npc: Eve? One of the greatest witches I know. Also the oldest person I know. She's been around for practically forever.
It is said that when she was alive she was a hard working witch, mastering advanced spells at a very young age.
Unfortunately she died while still a young adult. That's why she looks so young now, despite being centuries old.

steps.player: How can she still be around after all these years?

steps.npc: Like I said, she mastered spells at a very young age. She took some of that magic with her into the afterlife.
The sad truth about Eve is that she spent all her life working and striving to achieve great things.
But she never got to relax and appreciate how far she had come. That is why she is so obsessed with partying now.

steps.player: I understand. That really makes you think, doesn't it.

steps.npc: Indeed. Enjoy the moment while you can, because you may not get another. Take it from me, I'm a ghost.
